column1: # Book 4 review (Fable, 2026-10-30). Secondary 4.412 rejected: terrarum milia multa = many thousands of lands (Bailey, Munro, Rouse). Secondary 4.471 accepted in part: causam contendere = argue the case, not "my case". 4.395 pari ratione = on a like principle (register). 4.432-433, 4.435, 4.482 shortened to the band.

column2: And on a like principle the sun and the moon seem to stay
On the open sea, to sailors the sun, risen from the waves,
seems to set in the waves and to hide its light;
lest you lightly believe the senses are shaken on every side.
Against this man, then, I will forbear to argue the case,
Further, what ought to be held in greater trust than the senses?
